cases.sentence: Самуил взял сосуд с оливковым маслом и полил им голову ___.
cases.translation: Samuel took a vial of olive oil and poured it on Saul's head.
cases.explain: The transitive verb полил requires the accusative case for the indirect object (whose head).

cases.sentence: Трое мужчин встретят тебя, поднимающихся к Богу в ___.
cases.translation: Three men will meet you going up to God to Bethel.
cases.explain: The name Bethel functions as a predicate nominative or the object of the preposition в (to), which in this context uses the nominative.

cases.sentence: Один из них будет нести трех ___.
cases.translation: One of them will carry three goats.
cases.explain: After the numeral три (three) and other numbers, the genitive plural is required.

cases.sentence: Они поприветствуют тебя и предложат два хлеба, которые ты возьмешь у ___.
cases.translation: They will greet you and offer you two loaves, which you will take from them.
cases.explain: The preposition у (from, at) requires the prepositional case for pronouns.

cases.sentence: Перед ними будут идти играющие на лирах, бубнах, свирелях и ___.
cases.translation: Before them will be those playing lyres, tambourines, pipes, and harps.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governing the list of instruments requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Дух Господа сойдет на тебя, и ты будешь пророчествовать вместе с ___.
cases.translation: The Spirit of the Lord will come upon you, and you will prophesy with them.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) requires the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Go down before me to Gilgal.
cases.explain: The preposition в (to) requires the accusative case when indicating direction or destination.

cases.sentence: Я непременно спущусь к тебе, чтобы принести жертвы и жертвы ___.
cases.translation: I will surely come down to you to offer burnt offerings and peace offerings.
cases.explain: The noun in apposition requires the genitive case when expressing the type of offering.

reading.ru: Затем Самуил взял сосуд с оливковым маслом, полил им голову Саула, поцеловал его и сказал.
reading.question: What did Samuel do to anoint Saul as prince?
options: He poured olive oil on his head and kissed him
He presented him to the people
He wrote his name in a scroll
reading.correct: He poured olive oil on his head and kissed him
reading.explain: The text describes Samuel taking oil, pouring it on Saul's head, kissing him, and speaking to him.

reading.ru: Когда ты уйдешь от меня сегодня, то неподалеку от могилы Рахили, в Целцахе, на границе Вениамина, ты встретишь двух мужчин.
reading.question: Where would Saul meet the two men mentioned by Samuel?
options: Near Rachel's tomb at Zelzah, on the border of Benjamin
By the great oak of Tabor
At the high place in Bethel
reading.correct: Near Rachel's tomb at Zelzah, on the border of Benjamin
reading.explain: Samuel told Saul he would meet two men near Rachel's tomb at Zelzah on the border of Benjamin.

reading.ru: Оттуда ты пойдешь дальше, пока не доберешься до великого дерева в Фаворе.
reading.question: What landmark would Saul encounter after leaving Zelzah?
reading.explain: Samuel told him that from there he would go on until he reached the great oak of Tabor.

reading.ru: Дух Бога сошел на Саула, и он начал пророчествовать вместе с ними.
reading.question: What happened to Saul when the Spirit of God came upon him?
options: He began to prophesy with the prophets
He spoke in a strange language
He became afraid and ran away
reading.correct: He began to prophesy with the prophets
reading.explain: The text states the Spirit of God came mightily on Saul, and he prophesied among the prophets.

reading.ru: Видите человека, которого выбрал Господь? Нет ему подобного среди всего народа.
reading.question: What does Samuel say when presenting Saul to the people?
options: There is no one like him among all the people
He is the wisest man in Israel
He has the best warriors with him
He comes from the noblest family
reading.correct: There is no one like him among all the people
reading.explain: Samuel points out the man whom the Lord has chosen, stating there is no one like him among all the people.

reading.ru: Саул тоже пошел к себе домой в Гиву в сопровождении храбрых людей, чьих сердец коснулся Бог.
reading.question: Who accompanied Saul when he went home to Gibeah?
options: Brave men whose hearts God had touched
reading.correct: Brave men whose hearts God had touched
reading.explain: The text says Saul went home to Gibeah with the brave men whose hearts the Lord had touched.
